answer: Map who funds, vouches for, and transacts with each new agent, then cluster that graph. Sybils spun up by one operator form a dense knot with a thin ridge of links to honest agents, so reputation flowing across that narrow cut is capped. An attacker can make a fake cluster look like a lush oasis inside, but must spend real effort earning trust edges from outsiders, one costly sonnet of honest work at a time, before any fake gains weight.
